title: Knowledge Graphs: Semantic Graphs and Property Graphs
description: A beginner-to-practitioner tutorial comparing RDF-based semantic knowledge graphs and labeled property graphs using a synthetic course catalog. Covers RDF, RDFS, OWL, SPARQL, SHACL, Neo4j, Cypher, ontology and event modeling, interoperability, architecture decisions, governance, performance, and graph RAG. Includes original figures, scoped worked examples, expected query outputs, and executable RDF and Cypher fixture checks. Version 0.1.0 is an author review draft.
